rules.statement: A deed registered in the wrong folio is void as against parties claiming an adverse interest on valuable consideration by virtue of a subsequent duly registered deed.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is clear that a deed which is not registered in the proper place is not 'so registered' for the purpose of section 17."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 17 of Ordinance No. 14 of 1891, every deed, &c, unless ' so registered ' shall be deemed void, &c.
